scope: Residual actual purchase forms for tentative final corpus; research only. Zero-based observation references. No price, stock, retailer production integration or nutrient import.

region_evidence.wording: Official neutral vegetable category expressly lists Saint Petersburg delivery; product evidence paired separately.

exclusions: Prepared curry sauces, curries, mild cheese or consumer reviews do not clear mild curry powder.
Fried onions with flour/oil, green onion and onion powder occurring inside composite foods do not clear standalone onion powder.
Smoked/salted salmon and turkey thighs are wrong forms/species.
Third-party flyer aggregators, unrelated-city pages and expired2025/2026 promotional PDFs were not used as current qualifying product proof.
